instruction: How to use weasyprint to create a PDF with custom footnotes
output: weasyprint -s '@page { @bottom-left { content: 'Draft'; } @bottom-right { content: counter(page); } }' input.html output.pdf

instruction: How to use weasyprint to create a PDF with first page header
output: weasyprint -s '@page :first { @top-center { content: 'First Page Header'; } }' input.html output.pdf

instruction: How to set weasyprint string set for headers
output: weasyprint -s 'h1 { string-set: doctitle content(); } @page { @top-center { content: string(doctitle); } }' input.html output.pdf

instruction: How to create PDF from HTML with weasyprint using target counters
output: weasyprint -s 'a::after { content: ' [Page ' target-counter(attr(href), page) ']'; }' input.html output.pdf
